# OSS Intake: MCP TypeScript v2 Client Beta

- Official repository: `https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk`
- Package/module: `@modelcontextprotocol/client@2.0.0-beta.4`; transitive official `@modelcontextprotocol/core@2.0.0-beta.4`.
- Exact tag/commit/version: annotated tags `@modelcontextprotocol/client@2.0.0-beta.4` (`5aa0a82829f83b6b62a8ce41531921b34180ff84`) and `@modelcontextprotocol/core@2.0.0-beta.4` (`418b7f88b405ea95f0db62b4780b555c673c9d82`) both resolve to commit `e81758caed29f6568ce8873f7f9a3bd65b017d9c`. Client integrity `sha512-VNHA/UXDk7mCpVl+jOg5B4WMRRD2OEl+it360Lhi6HiCbrIB2f6pZ0cqSDKXQVUtZvqnhdQHzZAM9h8EKWhq/A==`; core integrity `sha512-nsMXd4wQBKzmph6r+WOhum+mXjDYljTAqwY/XUg3hLtvNOQ8+JVqBSJOVCMJvx9lXhTpTOPrGZ3BuNiaNPjSvg==`.
- License and NOTICE: package metadata declares MIT. The exact repository transition root LICENSE contains Apache-2.0, MIT and CC-BY-4.0 sections, SHA-256 `0382B0057770CA05E9C350A50AA3B1C1FEA84DA0BC81D723BF00B9AA841BE58A`; no root NOTICE is present at the pin. Packaged license artifacts and the generated SBOM remain release-gate inputs.
- Requested use: exact direct production dependency for the official Client and Streamable HTTP transport; core is transitive.
- Files/APIs inspected: published package metadata, annotated tags, `Client`, automatic version negotiation, Streamable HTTP client transport/fetch seam, client/server extension capabilities, era/result codec behavior, request options and low-level validated request boundary.
- Capability needed: negotiate extension-era MCP connections while retaining official legacy fallback, then carry the separately pinned `io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks` requests behind the adapter.
- Why current authoritative components cannot provide it: SDK 1.29.0 negotiates only through `2025-11-25`; the extension explicitly cannot be enabled for that legacy protocol.
- Boundary/adapter: production imports are allowed only in `packages/mcp-adapter`. Domain and application own independent result/task/capability DTOs. The existing SDK 1.29.0 remains only for legacy loopback Server test support during this staged migration.
- Maintenance/upgrade plan: exact beta pin; schema/protocol compatibility contracts; no range upgrade. Every beta change requires source diff, Intake, ADR and full protocol gate. Remove the v1 fixture dependency when an official v2 Server fixture replaces it.
- Security/quality findings: beta API and protocol revision may change. The package requires Node >=20, which the repository already requires. Modern protocol fixtures identify `2026-07-28`, while the frozen extension draft identifies `2026-06-30`; SDAR records the negotiated revision and claims compatibility only for the tested combination. The beta codec rejects the extension Task discriminator and its transport does not derive `Mcp-Name` from `taskId`; ADR-081 confines a method/result/Header compatibility bridge to the adapter and requires exact-wire tests. Unknown capabilities, discriminators, task IDs, states and payload fields fail closed.
- License obligations: retain packaged license text/copyright notices, list direct/transitive packages in SBOM/notices, and do not copy SDK implementation source.
- Decision and ADR: accepted by ADR-081. This does not authorize a second Workflow Runtime or SDK type leakage.
